audit.why: Brand's W-E combo and Blaze burn out-pokes Karma's un-empowered Q pre-6; levels 4-5 flatten because Mantra-Q outranges Brand's W and RE peels his engage.

audit.corrected: Moved phases[0,1,2,4,5,6].side to 'Brand' to match win[] and rewrote each .why with the content layer's kit-grounded reasoning. Left row 3 (Levels 4-5) untouched — both layers already agree at 'Skill'.

edits.before: W-poke the pair — the pillar splashes bot's formation tax from level 1.
edits.after: At level 1 your W and Blaze passive out-poke Karma's lone Q.

edits.before: E joins: the ablaze-stun package threatens; the lane flinches at level 2.
edits.after: Your level-2 W-on-E burst beats her non-empowered poke.

edits.before: Full kit: E-Q stuns through the wave and the W bills the dodge attempt.
edits.after: At level 3 your combo damage and stun threat pressure her lane.

edits.before: Pyroclasm online — grouped duos pay the bounce tax; never lane in a line.
edits.after: Your level-6 Pyroclasm out-threatens her ult-less kit for kills.

edits.before: First item: the burn compounds and the stun package deletes.
edits.after: First-item Blaze burn out-sustains her Mantra shields.

edits.before: Late support Brand is a teamfight bill: spread the blaze, R the clump, and stun the survivors.
edits.after: At 2+ items your sustained burn and Pyroclasm still beat her soft CC.

edits.before: W the pair, E the ablaze, Q the stun, walk — the package billed two and the burn collects after.
edits.after: Land E then Q on the same target — the doubled spread and stun beat her before Mantra-E shields it.

edits.before: Q-poking clean targets while the engage waits — the unablazed Q is the kit's most expensive miss.
edits.after: Splitting Q onto the support alone lets her ADC poke free while Focused Resolve heals the tether.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Liandry's, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Liandry's, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early — Focused Resolve (W) sustains through it.

edits.before: Commit on Focused Resolve (Tether)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make him flinch first.
edits.after: Commit on Focused Resolve (Tether)’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Make her flinch first.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E-Q stun package banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): 12s cooldown — break the root with range or line of sight before it snaps. Her tempo bends around it. - Keep E-Q stun package banked for their best play. - Mantra (R, 40/38/36/34s) is a fight decision, not a habit.
